# Stage 4: compatibility, bounded reliability and integration

All selected local execution is complete. Functional compatibility passes in the observed cells; this does not qualify all models, runtimes or environments, establish equal useful-answer quality, or promise a speedup in each configuration. The [selected matrix](SUPPORT_MATRIX.md) and [machine-readable attempts](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/support-matrix.json) retain the exact scope and all replacements.

## Measured workflow performance

| Selected cell | Wait batch time saved versus ARC | Conditional 95% interval | Predeclared timing disposition |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| [stage4-graphs](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/stage4-graphs-summary.json) | +8.87% | +8.08 to +9.65% | Useful 2% point target and positive interval met; 2% neutral bound met |
| [stage4-qwen15-performance](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/stage4-qwen15-performance-summary.json) | +3.06% | -5.28 to +10.75% | Useful gain unresolved; 2% neutral bound unresolved |
| [stage4-qwen15-cohost](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/stage4-qwen15-cohost-summary.json) | +4.67% | -1.18 to +10.17% | Useful gain unresolved; 2% neutral bound met |
| [stage4-minimal-performance](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/stage4-minimal-performance-summary.json) | +4.28% | -0.75 to +9.07% | Useful gain unresolved; 2% neutral bound met |

Each cell has three rotated whole-run pairs. These are conditional fixed-input intervals, not population uncertainty or a simultaneous superiority claim. No cohort pooling, favorable extension or serving-parameter search follows. Every slower pair remains in its alarm receipt; complete measurement is not product qualification.

Graph-mode performance has actual timed FULL-dispatch evidence in all six cases, after a conservative allowance for every untimed request. The source telemetry is recorded after the explicit replay branch completes; it excludes capture/profiling work and changes no graph dispatch, allocation, kernel or retention policy. First-pair prefill is 66,457 ARC versus 53,673 wait, with slightly more candidate output and zero preemptions. This is within-mode performance, not a graph-versus-eager experiment. [Graph receipts](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/stage4-graphs-graph-receipts.json).

The 1.5B full-budget cell has zero CPU loads, prior CPU-eviction returns and preemptions in all six cases, with essentially identical prefill work. Its larger third-pair advantage includes fewer generated tokens; no CPU-retention contribution is established. The constrained-byte cell saves first-pair prefill (67,498→54,958) while generating slightly more output, but its speed-gain interval remains unresolved. Actual byte budgets were selected before evaluation, not searched. [Full-budget inspection](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/stage4-qwen15-full-inspection.json), [constrained first pair](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/stage4-qwen15-cohost-first-pair.json).

The bounded audit-off profile is measured directly with real repository workflows. Native before/after counter provenance and raw workflow records replace unavailable detailed agent histories. Its 64 timed requests and 48 tools per case are separated from the intentional after-timing cancellation; native abort, drain, recovery and cleanup pass. No per-key lifetime, first-admission or per-request-transfer proof is fabricated. [Native/profile receipts](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/stage4-minimal-native-receipts.json).

The [quality report](QUALITY.md) retains known wrong coverage claims in 7B answers and weak/missing code symbols in 1.5B answers. A 1.5B candidate answer lists an actually successful test as both passed and not passed. Human-readable PASS formatting misses are adjudicated separately without changing original scores. None of these timings establishes equal-quality successful repository analysis.

## Functional and operational coverage

All eight selected functional cells pass all six expected waves, actual pinned/shared backing and native cancellation/drain/recovery. They cover short 7B AWQ, unquantized 1.5B, OPT125M MHA, bounded audit-off, abandoned advice, long 7B, long 1.5B and long 7B graphs. Short probes use 1,024-token context limits; long probes use 8,192-token limits with real document targets up to 6,000 tokens. Their cache-byte conversions and combined-cell limits are in the [support matrix](SUPPORT_MATRIX.md).

Cached candidate returns must actually restore CPU KV; fresh references recompute their entire prompts with zero external hits and agree on exact greedy IDs. The abandoned-advice cell instead requires full recomputation and no restore after churn. Namespace, stale-clock, future-information and duplicate-identity checks validate exact expected responses. This is observed generation correctness, not direct KV byte equality or all-position support. Diagnostic spans include extra candidate protocol RPCs; their retained timing losses are not matched application-performance comparisons.

The actual CPU buffers are checked with Tensor.is_pinned(), shared load/store backing and rounded byte geometry; environment flags alone are insufficient. Stage 2–3 already retain the independent native-worker/LMCache allocation observer; Stage 1 lacks that observer. The new startup receipt additionally covers the standalone example, whose environment clears the observer path.

## Integration, installation and version boundary

Both the [public standalone client](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/example-client/result.json) and [isolated GPU client](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/isolated-example-client/result.json) pass a real SHA-256 subprocess, positive ready-CPU refresh, actual pinned backing, drain and owned cleanup. They are integration checks, not saved-work measurements. The isolated 2,874-file source copy and own environment follow the published installation commands offline, pass native imports,60 focused tests and module/binary/source-path checks, and remain byte-identical after GPU serving. [Isolation result](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/isolated-reproduction/result.json).

This is same-host author reproduction, not an independent person or benchmark-timing reproduction. The actual202-package installation includes201 dependencies plus the extension; seven transitive versions differ from the primary environment. Both observed closures and installation logs are retained, and the primary environment was untouched. [Reproduction instructions](REPRODUCING.md).

The actual pinned0.26.1rc1.dev75+gdc1be7903 overlay imports/constructs the extension and required native hooks. The newer published retention runtime0.1.dev1+g7966f717d.precompiled fails actual extension import because BlockStatus/chunk APIs changed and required publication/scheduler/allocation hooks differ. It is unsupported, not silently ported or a mechanism failure. Other GPU/native-Linux/BF16/distributed/hybrid configurations remain untested. [Positive API receipt](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/runtime-pinned-interface.json), [unsupported revision](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/runtime-newer-interface.json).

## Retained failures and evidence repairs

| Original attempt | Observed failure | Explicit replacement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| runtime-probe | Probe adapter expected the wrong400error envelope and lacked eager directional-counter provenance; actual generation/core behavior passed | runtime-probe-repaired; exact API response and native parser provenance fixed,37 qualification/V2 checks passed before fresh retry |
| runtime-probe-opt125 | Selected snapshot contained config only; control failed before requests | Same pinned revision completed with weights/tokenizer, unchanged configuration/spec: runtime-probe-opt125-complete |
| runtime-probe-abandon, runtime-probe-abandon-declared | All actual behavior/operational checks passed, but inherited generic restore activity contradicted intentional no-restore; the first repair missed the condition-level override | runtime-probe-abandon-effective changes only both effective activity declarations and verifies them before retry |

All original failed/inconclusive attempts remain sealed and visible in [replacement provenance](../../output/wait-qualification-20261105/compatibility-replacements.json), the catalog and comparison export. Neither activity repair changes policy, budget, corpus or the behavioral no-restore assertion. Source/allocation/V2 telemetry repairs were applied and frozen at the Stage 3 quiet boundary before Stage 4 measurements. The later protocol-adapter repair has its separate pre-retry freeze. Primary focused 60, benchmark 131 and final qualification/V2-telemetry 37 checks passed; the portable final checks have their separate log.

The [regression report](REGRESSIONS.md) and Stage 3 exposure retain the unresolved operating range. Finite observations do not establish an unbounded-session limit, leak freedom or a production failure rate. Full earlier investigation notes remain in `output/wait-qualification-20261105/stage4-before-final.md`; no result was discarded.
